headline: Prioritize billing/support: premium gating of basic features drives the largest billing complaint load and expressed cancellation intent.
recommendation: The billing topic has 50,397 complaints [T9], 17.1% of all complaints [T12], and 9,552 cancellation-intent records [T11], the highest cancellation count of any topic. Within billing, the premium paywall issue has 41,553 complaints [C5] and a severity sum of 115,758 [C6]. Usability has more total complaints (77,884 [T1]) but is split across ads, controls and navigation, so a single fix would reach less of it.

actions.title: Review which basic features sit behind premium
actions.rationale: Users say core features like shuffle and song selection are locked, which is the paywall issue with 41,553 complaints [C5]. A clear audit of free-tier features would show where gating is causing the complaints.

actions.title: Add clearer free-tier messaging and support paths for paywall questions
actions.rationale: Reviews describe the app as premium-only, and billing support complaints are tracked separately at 586 [T29]. Clearer messaging before users hit a paywall could reduce complaints without changing the pricing model.

alternatives.why_not_first: Usability has the most complaints at 77,884 [T1], but it is split across ads 37,172 [C9], shuffle and track control 19,039 [C13] and navigation 14,052 [C17], so no single fix covers it.
Playback stops or skips has 10,266 complaints [C21] with a severity sum of 31,365 [C22], but the playback topic has only 2,466 cancellation-intent records [T15].
Login failure has high mean severity at 3.887905 [C31], but only 6,887 complaints [C29], which is a smaller and narrower group.

limitations: Reviews are self-selected public posts, so they do not represent the full user base.
The data has no revenue, plan tier, or confirmed churn; cancellation records are expressed intent only.
96,340 records need review [X8] and the verifier's topic agreement is 0.8524 [X10], so issue-level counts carry classification uncertainty.
Quoted reviews are illustrative examples and do not measure how common each complaint is.
